metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which only cover this project's own files. page.test.ts generates the docs page apps/docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/realm-policies.md from the schema (`pnpm nx test server-realm-policy -- -u` rewrites it, formatted with Oxfmt and the repo's `.oxfmtrc.json`), and the contract test checks that every field's docs link names a page of the docs site and a heading on it, so the docs pages, the formatter and its configuration are inputs too. Setting `inputs` REPLACES the inferred array, so the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, with `oxfmt` added to the external dependencies.
